verdict.rationale: Per-end-user credential isolation is a fair question for an MCP gateway and hosting platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only gateway-level credential management, per-tool enable/disable, and OAuth testing in the inspector. Nothing shows separate connected accounts or scoped tokens per end user of the customer's product.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can maintain separate connected accounts and scoped tokens per end user of my product, so each user's agent acts only on that user's credentials
